services.value: Provides environmental testing services including Asbestos in Bulk Material (Friable & Non-Friable) by (PLM & TEM), Fiber in Air by PCM, Lead in Wipe, Paint, Soil and Air, Coli/E.Coli for Potable Water, Total Bacteria Count (HPC) for Potable and Non-Potable Water, Mold Identification, Legionella, and Water Treatment Consulting.
